name: io.github.extralabs/sprutmonitor-mcp
title: SprutMonitor DLP
description: SprutMonitor Cloud read-only MCP: risks, idle, productivity, monitoring.

environmentVariables.name: SPRUT_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: SprutMonitor web API address, including the cloud. Example: https://cloud.sprutmonitor.ru/v3 or http://192.168.1.8:82/MonitorServer/.

environmentVariables.name: SPRUT_EMAIL
environmentVariables.description: Account login for https://app.sprutmonitor.ru/, or an extra user from Settings - Access.

environmentVariables.name: SPRUT_TOOLSETS
environmentVariables.description: Tool filter: all | core | console (console includes core).
